module Homebrew
  module Bootsnap
    def self.key
      @key ||= begin
        require "digest/sha2"

        checksum = Digest::SHA256.new
        checksum << RUBY_VERSION
        checksum << RUBY_PLATFORM
        checksum << Dir.children(File.join(Gem.paths.path, "gems")).join(",")

        checksum.hexdigest
      end
    end
